messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a Terraform PR to migrate the ml-inference service from k8s Ingress -> Gateway API and enable TLS passthrough. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 Please eyeball secret wiring + port mapping before I merge.

alejandro: looking now. main concern is how the TLS secret is referenced (we need it to be a k8s secret annotated for KMS unwrap). Can you paste the TF snippet for the secret binding?

maria: sure — PR includes this small module:
```hcl
module "gateway_tls_secret" {
  source = "./modules/k8s-secret"
  name   = "ml-inference-tls"
  data = { 
    tls.crt = file("../certs/ml-inference.crt")
    tls.key = file("../certs/ml-inference.key")
  }
  annotations = {
    "kms.redwood.com/key" = "projects/prod/keys/gateway-cert"
    "kms.redwood.com/unwrapped" = "false"
  }
}
```

alejandro: hmm we shouldn't set unwrapped=false on the Secret itself — that flag is read by the controller that does envelope decryption. For Gateway listeners we expect the TLS cert to be a plain k8s TLS secret at apply time. The KMS unwrap flow happens during secret creation; make sure the controller has permissions.

sam: quick infra question — with Gateway API + TLS passthrough are we keeping NLB in front (L4) or doing TLS termination at the Gateway (L7)? For ml-inference we want client cert passthrough to the app.

jin: if you need client certs to reach pods, use TLS Passthrough on the listener + NLB TCP. Example gateway listener snippet: 
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: ml-gateway
spec:
  gatewayClassName: nlbgw
  listeners:
  - name: tls-tcp
    protocol: TLS
    port: 443
    allowedRoutes:
      kind: HTTPRoute
      namespaces:   # not used for passthrough routes
        from: All
    tls:
      mode: Passthrough
      certificateRefs: [] # empty for passthrough
```

jin: that requires the cloud LB to be in TCP mode. Our NLB setup works for that; ALB does not support passthrough.

maria: ok i'll set gatewayClass to `nlbgw` and add the service annotation to force NLB: `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"` and `service.kubernetes.io/target-port: "8080"` on the svc.

alejandro: +1 on NLB. For the secret flow: remove the unwrapped annotation and ensure the infra service account used by the secret-controller has kms:Decrypt on the key. I'll add a small IAM change in the same PR.

infra-bot: terraform plan (staging) succeeded — no changes to existing nodegroups, 3 resources to add: module.gateway_tls_secret.kubernetes_secret, k8s_gateway.ml-gateway, k8s_gatewayclass.nlbgw. Plan: https://ci.redwood.dev/plans/78234

sam: one more: confirm targetPort mapping. Our container listens on 8080 for tls and 9090 for metrics. If NLB does passthrough to 8080 we need readinessProbe on that port. Don't forget podSecurityPolicy to allow hostPort if anyone used it.

maria: noted — i'll update the Deployment readinessProbe and add the service targetPort mapping in the TF.

alejandro: added an IAM diff to the PR for the KMS key policy and a note about rotating the key (we should coordinate with security).

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled to staging cluster at 11:30 UTC once CI passes.

maria: thanks all. I'll remove the unwrapped annotation, add the NLB annotations and the readinessProbe fix, then re-request review from @alejandro and @jin. If CI is green i'll merge and follow up with a short post in #incidents if anything weird happens. :thumbsup:

alejandro: sounds good.

jin: lgtm for the Gateway bits — ping me if the listener behaves weird in staging.
